correctness.rationale: The closed pair decay matrix reduces on the star to an unsigned complete-leaf incidence block. The two positive singular values give the stated two-by-two blocks and the kernel gives the unpaired modes. Perron–Frobenius puts the lowest mode in the constant block. The Rayleigh bound is λ|F|/binom(n,2), so it specializes to 2λ/n for trees with feedback on all edges; rationalization gives asymptotic saturation. A positive sine mode gives the ring rate at unit edge clocks and maximal feedback. The quadratic sign comparison proves the crossover for every n. The full gap identity is attributed to arXiv:2611.13094v2 Eq. (78) for its connected SWAP feedback model. The finite checker concerns the pair sector only.
